ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.25 (1:4 ratio of high-intensity white/light-grey pixels to low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity black region (0-45 RGB) across central lobes. High-intensity white contiguous zones (>210 RGB) localized on the distal tips, most prominent on the far-left tip. High-frequency white punctate mottling distributed across the lower-left quadrant and inferior-central regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow U-shaped depression; calculated interior angle of approximately 115 degrees with a shallow bounding-box depth relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the trailing boundary; peak-to-valley amplitude varies between 3-8 pixels, with highest frequency density localized on the outer third of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex curvature from the median notch extending to the distal tips, transitioning to a slight upward recurve at the terminal edges.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High density of circular white pixel clusters (diameter 2-12 pixels) scattered across the ventral surface of the left lobe and lower-central region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct vertical linear disruptions of light-grey pixels (~50 pixels in length) located on the right lobe immediately adjacent to the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged topography of the trailing edge suggesting accumulated physical wear; extensive white rosette-style scarring clusters on the dark pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced high-contrast white patch on the far-left distal tip that transitions abruptly into the primary dark pigmentation.
